prior: actual G0, exact conditional common-zero-delay PDP mixture integrated numerically, no latent PDP supplied to features
coordinate_alignment: Gaussian frozen prediction multiplied by [2*public_delta,1,exp(public_logtau),exp(public_lognoise)] only at the one public destination point; source prior/base point/chirps still differ, so it is labeled proxy mismatch
failure_rule: all teacher nonconverged observations retained and counted, never score successful subset
independence: 1280 independent exact latent continuous draws, disjoint train/validation/test; all quadratures and feature layers share observations
